source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I have checked the changes and everything looks good. Please provide the final files as editable templates in Canva, along with final PDF exports for RR01, RR02, RR03 and RR04. Please also include any fonts, icons, logos, colour codes and design assets needed so I can edit and export future customer reports myself. After this we can conclude the project and I will release the funds.

Thanks

routing_warnings.description: This message requests editable source files capable of producing customer-ready PDFs, rather than delivery of final PDF exports.
The freelancer claims delivery of editable Word and Canva versions but does not claim delivery of final PDF exports.
